'''Yalawua''' was a squat located to the north of [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]] within the borders of the [[Scraplands/Legends|Scraplands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Hivelike, the squat was inhabited by a colony of [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] rumored to have fled [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] after the loss of their village to [[Tusken/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Yalawua's residents survived by trading refurbished droid parts and guiding lost travelers through the wastes.<ref name="MPQ" />
